agent_notes: The official Jaipur campus page and its programme navigation display PGDM (Service Management), but the linked official detail URL returns HTTP 404; the visible Jaipur programmes catalogue currently lists only PGDM and FPM (Doctoral Level Programme). The active Jaipur catalogue is therefore incomplete or internally inconsistent and requires manual review.
The central official catalogue lists PGDM and FPM for Jaipur; other specialized PGDM entries there are campus-specific to Lucknow or Noida and were excluded.
Career mappings were read from assets/data/career_path.db using read-only SQLite queries; no database edits were made.

Normal TLS verification produced the exact self-signed certificate-in-chain proxy error. After confirming the expected official/search hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure only as permitted.
